suite_sources_name_uq.name: suite_sources_name_uq
suite_sources_name_uq.where: name is not null and last_outcome <> 'missing'

suite_sources_current_ck.name: suite_sources_current_ck
suite_sources_current_ck.value: "suite_sources"."last_outcome" not in ('created', 'unchanged', 'reverted') or "suite_sources"."current_suite_id" is not null

tasks_valid_complete_ck.name: tasks_valid_complete_ck
tasks_valid_complete_ck.value: not "tasks"."valid" or ("tasks"."summary" is not null and "tasks"."prompt" is not null and "tasks"."limits" is not null and "tasks"."reference" is not null)

mcp_server_versions_shape_ck.name: mcp_server_versions_shape_ck
mcp_server_versions_shape_ck.value:
("mcp_server_versions"."transport" = 'stdio' and "mcp_server_versions"."command" is not null and "mcp_server_versions"."command" <> '' and "mcp_server_versions"."url" is null and cardinality("mcp_server_versions"."header_names") = 0)
       or ("mcp_server_versions"."transport" = 'http' and "mcp_server_versions"."url" is not null and "mcp_server_versions"."command" is null and cardinality("mcp_server_versions"."args") = 0 and cardinality("mcp_server_versions"."env_names") = 0)

evaluations_claim_ck.name: evaluations_claim_ck
evaluations_claim_ck.value: "evaluations"."status" <> 'running' or ("evaluations"."claim_token" is not null and "evaluations"."claim_expires_at" is not null)
